args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, 8 accepted (r01–r08), 0 flagged, 8 cleared.
- Final checks: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections were run and passed in all eight runs. No run used the width-free ratio.
- Strain-rate profiles: every run has the centre strain-rate (REGR) peak at 421 µm and the largest flank difference at 410 µm. REGR peaks range from 52.75 to 52.92 %/h, and growth-zone lengths from 674 to 705 µm.
- Large |z| values: these appear in r01, r06 and r08 only because the batch MAD is 0. The actual differences are 3% or less; the largest is r08's growth zone, 674 vs 695 µm.
- Remedies: r06 is the only run that kept a remedy (frames registered on non-growing tissue from 400 px). With it, all checks pass and the profile matches the batch.
- Common pattern among flagged runs: none, since no run was flagged.
